prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 47-blob autotile sprite atlas for a top-down 2D arena game.
Input image: reference layout AND edit target, friendly base atlas of exactly 352x160 pixels, 11 columns by 5 rows of 32px tiles. Redesign into a hostile Void base. Output same 11:5 aspect ratio, preferably 1408x640 (each tile 128px); preserve the EXACT layout, silhouettes, tile boundaries, empty cells and hole placement of the reference, no padding.
Strict orthographic 90-degree top-down view. Keep the connected platform shapes of the reference, but create a DISTINCT architectural material: very dark charcoal obsidian armor slabs, angular beveled plate edges, subtle jagged hairline fractures and recessed geometric channels. Replace cyan bars with strongly saturated glowing violet Void energy strips (#a52bff to #ce68ff). Approximately 85 percent surface dark charcoal with restrained texture, 15 percent vivid purple energy accents mainly along exposed perimeter. Darker and more menacing than the reference. Change rounded socket details to angular diamond/square recesses with violet rims. This is NOT a hue swap: introduce angular layered armor, crisp bevels, restrained fractured mineral texture. Interior tiles subdued, seamless repeat, no central emblem.
Every existing outer rim stays at EXACTLY the same position as reference. Do not add borders along open tile connections. Preserve authentic transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, labels, grid guides, characters, turrets, side walls, perspective, floor underneath, cast shadows outside tiles or diffuse glow outside alpha. Readable at 32px tile size; broad clear material forms rather than excessive noise.
